pinned.name: Time_Warp_Studio
pinned.description: 🚀 Educational multi-language IDE supporting BASIC, PILOT, Logo, C, Pascal, Prolog & Forth with integrated turtle graphics, debugger, and themed editor. Built with Python/PySide6.

pinned.name: GulfOfMexico
pinned.description: Esoteric programming language interpreter — -1-based indexing, three-valued booleans, significant whitespace, tiered equality, temporal lifetimes, and word numbers. Based on Lu Wilson's (TodePond) design.

pinned.name: Time_Warp_II
pinned.description: Time Warp II — a special version of Time Warp Classic, built specifically for the TempleCode language (BASIC + PILOT + Logo fusion). Educational IDE with turtle graphics, syntax highlighting, and retro-computing charm.

pinned.name: Time_Warp_Classic
pinned.description: Time Warp Classic: back-to-basics Tkinter IDE for 9 vintage + modern languages with turtle graphics.

pinned.name: ParserCraft
pinned.description: 🎨 Create custom programming languages without writing a compiler.  Visual IDE, language templates, keyword remapping, and syntax customization.  Includes TeachScript - a working educational language. Transform Python into Spanish, create BASIC-like variants, or design your own language with JSON/YAML configs.

pinned.name: LifeGrid
pinned.description: Full-featured cellular automaton simulator with 6 game modes including Conway's Game of Life, High Life, Immigration Game, Rainbow Game, Langton's Ant, and Custom Rules. Features 20+ built-in patterns, interactive drawing tools, symmetry modes, and pattern save/load.
